description: We are Celestial Legacy, a creative and ambitious team passionate about space exploration, science, technology, and innovation. Our goal is to bring the stories of forgotten space missions to life through an engaging and interactive experience. We welcome creative thinkers and enthusiastic problem-solvers who want to make an impact. We are looking for teammates skilled in coding, web development, graphic design, storytelling, research, and 3D modelling.
summary:
SPACE ARCHIVE is an interactive website that explores human made objects left across our Solar System. It brings together information about spacecrafts, rivers, landers and scientific equipment from different space mission.

Through the website, users can explore space objects, visit a virtual space museum, learn about scientific discoveries, follow a timeline of important missions, and take quizzes to test user’s knowledge.

We created SPACE ARCHIVE because information about these objects is spread across many different sources, making it difficult to explore everything in one place. Our goal is to bring this information together in a simple and interesting way. 

We hope our project encourages people to learn more about space exploration and understand the history and achievements behind humanity’s journey beyond Earth.
details:
SPACE ARCHIVE is a website that allows people to learn about the different objects humans have left in space. It focuses on things like spacecrafts, rovers, landers, and scientific equipment from missions to the Moon, Mars and other parts of our Solar System.

The website has several sections. Users can explore space objects, visit a virtual space museum, read about scientific discoveries, look through a timeline of important missions and answer quizzes to test their knowledge.

The main benefit of our projects is that it brings information about space exploration in one place instead of making people search through many different websites. We hope it makes learning about space easier and more enjoyable and encourages people, to become more interested in science.

We developed the website using Lovable, an AI-powered website building platform. We also ChatGPT to help research and refine written content.

What makes our project creative is the way it combines an archive, a virtual museum, a timeline and quizzes into one interactive learning experience.

While developing the project, we considered the accuracy of how the information, the design, how easy the website is to use and how to make it interesting for different types of users.
